The '''Primary Monitoring Station''' was an installation within one of the cell blocks in the [[High Security Section]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] [[Prison/Legends|prison]] world of [[Belsavis/Legends|Belsavis]]. During the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire's]] [[Invasion of Belsavis|attack]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]], rioting [[Rattataki/Legends|Rattataki]] prisoners took control of the cell block.<ref name="TOR" />

Around [[3624 BBY]],<ref name="Date">{{TOR_updates|7.4}}</ref> during the [[Third Galactic War]], [[Alliance Commander|the Commander]] of the [[Eternal Alliance]] searched the area for the [[HK-24 series assassin droid]] [[Shebs]].<ref name="TOR:TMH">{{TORcite|exp=lots|type=general|The Memory Heist|Belsavis}}</ref>
